items.title_zh: 印第安纳波利斯逃跑的猴子“莫莫”喝啤酒骚乱后被抓获
items.title_en: Escaped monkey 'Momo' captured after it drinks beer and runs riot in Indianapolis
items.summary_zh: 这只名叫“莫莫”的难以捉摸的猴子在一次大胆的逃跑后被印第安纳波利斯当局安全捕获。周三晚上，这只猴子首次被报道失踪，随后展开了紧张的搜寻工作。周四早上，当莫莫被发现并最终被抓获时，事情有了突破。这只猴子的主人通过当地脸书失物招领宠物小组寻求帮助。
items.summary_en: The elusive monkey known as "Momo" has been safely captured by authorities in Indianapolis after making a daring escape. The monkey was first reported missing on Wednesday evening, leading to an intense search effort. On Thursday morning, there was a breakthrough when Momo was sighted and eventually captured. The monkey's owner had reached out for assistance through a local lost-and-found pets Facebook group.

items.title_zh: 动物走私：水獭、老鼠和28只海龟在曼谷飞往台北的航班上造成混乱
items.title_en: Animal smuggling: Otter, rat and 28 turtles cause chaos on Bangkok to Taipei flight
items.summary_zh: 在从曼谷飞往台北的航班上，一名乘客的手提行李中发现了一只水獭和一只老鼠。乘客和机组人员对这一发现感到震惊，引起飞机上的恐慌。机组人员迅速控制了局势，随后在机场的一个集装箱中发现了这些动物。目前该事件正在调查中，怀疑是一名女乘客走私动物通过安检。
items.summary_en: An otter and a rat were discovered stowed away in a passenger's hand luggage during a flight from Bangkok to Taipei. Passengers and crew members were shocked by the discovery, causing panic onboard the aircraft. The crew swiftly contained the situation and the animals were later found in a container at the airport. The incident is currently under investigation, with suspicions that a female passenger smuggled the animals through security checks.
